prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Desktop Companion Certificate", "Your pet is registered to your account and saved for your desktop session."]
1: ["Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to summon, move, and interact with your companion on your screen.", "Click pet to interact • Drag to move around screen • Right-click for menu"]
2: []
3: ["Upload & Verify Pet Photo", "Check your photo preview below to ensure optimal pet generation quality."]
4: ["Signing in links your desktop pet to your account so progress is never lost."]
5: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "We are configuring your pet's desktop behaviors. Feel free to minimize this window."]
6: ["Select Your Adoption Method", "Pick an instantly available pet companion or upload photos to generate a unique custom pet.", "Continue"]
7: ["Enable desktop alerts so you know when your pet steps onto your desktop."]
8: []
9: ["Choose Your Pet Companion", "Select your favorite starter pet to instantly bring companion animations to your desktop.", "Instant setup • Free companion included"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or pricing ('Free companion included')
